verdict.rationale: Sandbox0's docs cover the full loop programmatically. An agent can use a team API key with the Go/Python/TypeScript SDKs or raw HTTP API to claim sandboxes, run code through REPL or Cmd contexts, read files, and have the sandbox deleted via hard_ttl expiry. Native OpenAI Agents SDK and LangChain Deep Agents backends, plus a non-interactive `s0` CLI, support unattended operation. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented on-demand delete/teardown call (only TTL-driven deletion is shown), explicit documentation of capturing execution stdout/results, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end loop.
